rationale: The target-quarter residual is an undercount caused by real source rows present in staging but absent from unified holdings. The two missing 2025-06-30 fair-value rows exactly bridge the validated anchor gap without deleting or rescaling any existing holding. The same extraction defect leaves the same S4T equity row out in 2025-09-30 and 2025-12-31 and leaves the Apryse term loan out in 2025-09-30; adding only these source-backed rows fixes the affected quarters and avoids touching earlier quarters where staging anti-joins are dominated by unrelated subtotal or axis artifacts.
